requirements.text: Create a hero section showcasing AC services with a compelling headline, brief description of services offered, and a prominent call-to-action button for requesting service
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays at the top of the homepage
Headline clearly communicates AC services
Call-to-action button is visible and clickable

requirements.text: Build a services section listing core AC services including installation, repair, maintenance, and emergency service with icons and brief descriptions for each
acceptanceCriteria: Four main service categories are displayed
Each service has an icon and description
Services are presented in a grid or card layout

requirements.text: Implement a contact form section where users can submit their name, phone number, email, service type needed, and a message to request AC services
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes fields for name, phone, email, service type, and message
Form validates required fields before submission
Submitted requests are stored in the backend
User receives confirmation after successful submission

requirements.text: Create an about section highlighting company expertise, years of experience, certifications, and customer satisfaction commitment
acceptanceCriteria: About section is positioned on the homepage
Content describes company credibility and experience
Section includes relevant statistics or achievements

requirements.text: Design a footer with company contact information including phone number, email address, business hours, and social media links
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays at the bottom of all pages
Contact information is clearly visible
Business hours are listed
Social media icons are present

requirements.text: Apply a professional visual theme with a clean, modern design that conveys trust and reliability, using warm accent colors against neutral backgrounds, clear typography, and consistent spacing throughout the site
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme uses warm accents with neutral backgrounds
Typography is readable and professional
Layout is consistent across all sections
Design conveys trustworthiness appropriate for a service business

required: Professional AC technician working on an air conditioning unit, photorealistic style (ac-technician-hero.dim_1200x600.png)
Clean minimalist air conditioner installation icon with modern line art style (service-installation.dim_128x128.png)
Wrench and screwdriver crossed icon for AC repair services, simple flat design (service-repair.dim_128x128.png)
Checkmark with tools icon for maintenance services, clean vector style (service-maintenance.dim_128x128.png)
Lightning bolt with phone icon for emergency service, bold and urgent style (service-emergency.dim_128x128.png)
